observations: Sony PlayStation 4 console (original 'fat' model) standing vertically.
The console is wrapped in clear plastic film.

PS4 and Sony logos are visible on the console body.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrap obscures the actual surface condition of the console.
There is no photo of the console powered on or connected to a screen.

risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the PlayStation home screen.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity is unknown (500GB or 1TB).
risks.proof: Photo of the 'Storage' menu in System Settings.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The controller in the box may be a high-quality third-party clone.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model sticker on the back of the controller.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the menu.
Photo of the System Information screen showing the software version and storage capacity.
Video of the console reading a physical game disc.
Photo of the back of the controller showing the serial number and FCC ID.
response.reason: Only one photo is provided, and it shows a wrapped console that isn't powered on. Essential details like storage capacity and functional status are missing, and the watermark suggests this may be a dealer's stock photo.
